contents.name: Definition 1.10: norm on a vector space over K=R or C, including complex absolute homogeneity

Theorem 1.18: the convergence characterization of equivalent norms and its proof
contents.reason: This batch defines equivalence but does not claim the topology or convergence characterization.

contents.name: Definition 1.1: norm axioms with homogeneity for every scalar in the chosen field
contents.support: These are the general norm tests used via the real and complex norm definitions. The original local function N(x+iy)=|x|+2|y| is checked against all real norm axioms in steps 1.1, 1.2, and 2.1. Step 3.1 tests the stronger complex-homogeneity clause at lambda=i,z=1 and obtains 2≠1. Neither the exact weighted function nor that particular counterexample is attributed to this source.
